title: Response
description: One response from the plugin, discriminated by result or error, with exactly one present. A response carrying both is malformed: the plugin assigned a result and then failed, and reading the result would report success while discarding the failure. The envelope is open, so a profile may declare fields beside these and checks them in its own schema. The result schema belongs to the profile.

id.description: The id of the request being answered. 0 is reserved for a refusal whose request id the plugin could not determine.

error.description: A refusal: the plugin was reachable and reported that it could not do the work. A refusal is an answer, not a loss.
